messages:
Asha (People Ops): Posting a concise follow-up from today’s All-Hands Q&A thread. Putting the FAQ and next steps here so managers can copy/paste into 1:1s.

Maya (SWE): Thanks! Two quick asks: exact promotion schedule and whether equity refreshes are automatic with promos?

Asha (People Ops): Schedule: manager calibration notes due 2026-05-01, calibration committee meets 2026-05-08, official letters emailed 2026-05-15. Appeals window: 10 business days after letters. Equity: not automatic; request it in the packet if you think it should be considered.

Noah (Eng Manager): Payroll ops question: if an appeal is approved, do we backdate salary? People worried about timing.

Liam (Benefits): Retro-pay policy: approved base increases are backdated to the cycle effective date in the committee memo and paid on the next payroll run after HR posts the change (~2 weeks).

Ravi (People Ops): We're creating a short manager script + FAQ. Will include example language for "why not promoted" and a growth plan template. Draft to be shared 2026-04-28.

Maya (SWE): Can you share exact phrasing for "band vs level"? That was confusing for some folks.

Asha (People Ops): Use: "Level = scope/impact (what you do). Band = the pay range tied to market data. Same level, different points in a band are common." We'll add a one-line sample.

Noah (Eng Manager): Where do we upload calibration packets? I found two links in the handbook.

Asha (People Ops): Canonical upload: /handbook/people-ops/calibration/2026-summer (use the `calibration-template.xlsx`). Link will be in the manager digest.

Maya (SWE): If someone has an external offer, do we do counteroffers or a market adjustment review?

Asha (People Ops): We donft do blanket counteroffers. Managers can submit a market-adjustment case with evidence (offer, comps). The committee reviews these on a rolling basis and may approve retention adjustments.

Noah (Eng Manager): One more: will one-time spot bonuses affect band placement?

Liam (Benefits): No. One-time bonuses do not change comp band. Only permanent base changes affect band placement during calibration.

PeopleBot: Reminder: calibration packets due in 3 days for teams tagged beta. :pushpin:

Sam (CEO): Manager guidance: be transparent and focus on concrete examples + next-step milestones. Leadership will step in when cases are escalated.

Asha (People Ops): Action items (short):
- Manager script + FAQ published 2026-04-28
- Calibration template + single upload folder confirmed
- Managers finalize notes by 2026-05-01
- Committee meets 2026-05-08
- Letters out 2026-05-15; appeals 10 business days
- Add sample growth plan to manager packet

Maya (SWE): Thanks, helpful. Can the growth plan include 3 concrete milestones with timelines? That helps managers give clarity.

Asha (People Ops): Yes 00we'll include a 3-step milestone template. Closing the thread for follow-ups; ping me or Ravi for urgent escalations. :sparkles:
